<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the protected molecule, breaks the O‑Si bond to give the free alcohol and a silyl chloride (e.g., Cl[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C). The earlier search returned unrelated templates. To find the correct one, we should search the template catalog for reactions that break an O‑Si bond (or form a silyl ether in the forward direction). Using the “bonds_broken” criterion with the O‑Si bond should retrieve the appropriate silyl‑protection template. Once we have the template ID, we can return its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "bonds_broken": ["O-Si"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
